With $1984 in hand and p1 only at $99, I'm weighing whether to unmortgage Ventnor and Water Works, though the value seems marginal. More interesting is trying to buy Pacific from p1 to complete the green monopoly and build hotels—I'd need to pay off the mortgage plus interest, but it could be worth offering something like $150 given how cash-strapped p1 is.

Running the numbers, full hotels on the greens would run thousands in house costs which is overkill since p1 is already nearly broke and will likely go bankrupt soon from existing rents anyway. I'll just hold off on major spending this turn and maybe unmortgage Water Works cheaply before ending my turn.
